# tcpshield_network (Resource)

A TCPShield network — the unit that owns domains, backend sets, firewalls and Bedrock tunnels. Every setting is Optional + Computed: one left out of the configuration keeps the value TCPShield holds. Destroying it deletes the network and everything attached to it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tcpshield_network" "main" {
  name = "play.example.com"

  connections_per_second_threshold = 20
  client_ban_seconds               = 120
  vpn_block                        = true
  antivpn_kick_msg                 = "VPNs are not allowed on this server."

  offline_motd_enabled = true
  offline_motd         = "We are down for maintenance."
}

# Point your domain at the network and prove ownership:
output "cname" {
  value = tcpshield_network.main.protected_cname
}

output "txt_record" {
  value = tcpshield_network.main.txt_verification
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Network name.

### Optional

- `antivpn_kick_msg` (String) Kick message for a client blocked by `vpn_block`. Cannot be emptied — the API ignores `""`.
- `attack_emails` (Boolean) Send an email when an attack is detected.
- `client_allow_seconds` (Number) Seconds a client stays allowed after it passed verification, 1–600.
- `client_ban_seconds` (Number) Seconds a client stays banned once mitigation flags it, 1–3600.
- `connections_per_second_threshold` (Number) Connections per second above which mitigation starts, 1–100.
- `forward_true_slp` (Boolean) Forward server list pings to the backend instead of answering them at the edge.
- `mitigation_message` (String) Kick message shown to a client during mitigation. Cannot be emptied — the API ignores `""`.
- `offline_favicon` (String) Base64 favicon shown while every backend is down.
- `offline_kick_message` (String) Kick message shown while every backend is down.
- `offline_motd` (String) MOTD shown while every backend is down.
- `offline_motd_enabled` (Boolean) Answer pings with `offline_motd` while every backend is down.
- `verification_server` (Boolean) Route players through the verification server. Enterprise only: on any other plan the API answers `Your plan does not include the verification server.`
- `vpn_block` (Boolean) Block connections from known VPNs and proxies.
- `webhook_url` (String) Discord or Slack webhook notified when an attack starts or ends — the API rejects any other URL.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (Number) Numeric network id.
- `premium` (Boolean) Whether the network runs on a premium plan.
- `protected_cname` (String) CNAME the network's domains point at to be protected.
- `txt_verification` (String) TXT record value that proves ownership of the network's domains.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import tcpshield_network.main <network_id>
```
